text.en: Dog owners express complete confidence in Elodie and Emma, describing them as dependable, enthusiastic, and genuinely fond of each dog. Reviewers emphasize that the walkers treat pets as if they were their own family. Long-term clients highlight their reliability and accommodating scheduling over several years.

Clients frequently point out how shy, nervous, or reactive dogs grow substantially in confidence through structured group walks. Handlers appreciate that pack dynamics are carefully balanced so each dog feels secure and engaged. Reviewers note that puppies and rescue dogs come home happily exercised and relaxed.

Pet parents love receiving frequent photos, video clips, and cheerful updates documenting their dogs' outdoor excursions. Reviewers note that initial consultations are thorough, putting owners at ease before walks begin. This open communication gives handlers complete peace of mind while at work or travelling.

q.en: Do owners receive updates during the walks?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention receiving photos and video clips from each walk to see their dogs' adventures.

q.en: Can nervous or reactive dogs join group walks?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report that shy, nervous, and reactive dogs gradually gained confidence through carefully supervised pack walks.

q.en: Are puppy home visits offered before full walks?

a.en: Yes, handlers mention booking early puppy visits to provide company and playtime before young dogs transition to group walks.
